Ku lw’Erinnya lya Allah (Katonda) Omusaasizi Oweekisa ekingi, Oweekisa ekyenjawulo
Amatendo gonna (amajjuvu) ga Allah Omulezi W’ebitonde.
Nnannyini kusaasira okungi ennyo asaasira ebitonde Bye.
Nnannyini buyinza Yekka ku Lunaku lw'okusasula (Olunaku lw'Enkomerero).
Ggwe Wekka Ggwe tusinza era Ggwe Wekka Ggwe tusaba okutuyamba.
Ekkubo ly’abo be wagabira ebyengera, abatali abo be wasunguwalira era abatali abo abaabula.
